content: “Sikiyu is menge tig-Israel, he is menge kepuun niw impeǥawas te Nengazen diyà te Ehipto, pemineǥa niw is menge lalag din he ebpekesuǥat keniyu:
Diyà te langun he menge nasyun kayi te tivuuk he kelibutan iyan kew zà mibpilì ku he mehimu he menge etew ku. Umbe edsilutan ku sikiyu tenged te langun he menge salè niw.”
Ketau te Nengazen is Buluhaten te menge Ebpeneuven
Ebpezumehè be is dezuwa he etew te kedhipanew emun wazè dan mehuna meuyun?
Edhiniǥer ve is erimaung diyà te ketelunan emun wazè din edewiyen? Edhiniǥer ve sikandin diyà te elesè din emun wazè din nezawi?
Egketuǥesan be is tagbis emun wazà epani is penuǥes? Egkevekas be is penuǥes emun wazè din egkevekasan?

Kenè be egkerkeren te kegkahandek is menge etew emun edaǥing is menge vudyung te kebpesayud he zuen menge kuntada he edsurung? Emun egkeumahan te kezeetan is inged kenè be ketau te Nengazen is kebpekeuma zutun?
Benar iyan, wazà minsan hengkey he ebeelan te Nengazen he MEGBEVAYÀ emun wazè din ikehuna ikepezayag diyà te menge suluǥuen din he menge ebpeneuven.
Hentei man is kenà egkahandek emun edhiniǥer is erimaung? Hentei man is kenà ebpekekaǥi te menge lalag te Nengazen he MEGBEVAYÀ emun iyan en is Nengazen he MEGBEVAYÀ ebpekaǥi kandin?
Is Kedhukumi te Megbevayà te Samaria

Keǥiyi niw is menge pengulu he ed-ubpà diyà te melig-en he menge vahin te Ashdod wey is diyà te Ehipto he medtiǥum sikandan diyà te menge vuntud he nekeliǥuy te Samaria ne ahàa zan is kegubut kayi he inged wey is kedlisliseza te menge meǥinged kayi.

Su iyan heini kes migkaǥi te Nengazen he MEGBEVAYÀ he ebpekesuǥat te Samaria: “Kenè dan metau he edtinazeng, ne is melig-en he menge vahin te inged dan, nepenù te menge azen he tinakew wey tinavan. Umbe edsurungen sikandan te menge kuntada zan ne ebpemengkaǥen is menge pengalang dan. Egkuwaan te menge kuntada is menge azen diyà te melig-en he menge vahin te inged dan.”

Heini pa is migkaǥi te Nengazen: “Is egkekuwa te vantey te kerehidu zuen te uyaǥen he edeesan te erimaung egkehimu he iyan dà is dezuwa he vuvun etawa sevaha te telinga. Ne iring keniyan is egkehitavù keniyu te menge Israilihanen he menge meǥinged diyà te Samaria; is egkesamà keniyu, iyan dà is menge vahin te mekempet he menge hizeǥaan niw.”
Migkaǥi is Nengazen he MEGBEVAYÀ, kes Megbevayà he Mekeǥeǥehem, ke sikandin te, “Pemineǥa niw heini is egkeǥiyen ku ne tudtula niw ziyà te menge kevuwazan ni Jacob:

Dutun te andew te kedsiluti ku te menge tig-Israel tenged te menge salè dan, edweǥayen ku is menge pemuhatà diyà te Betel. Epungelen ku is menge sungeysungey te menge suyuk te pemuhatà ne egkengeulug heini ziyà te tanà.

Edrundusen ku is menge valey zan he para te timpu te meǥenew wey menge valey he para te timpu te meinit. Edrundusen ku zaan is mahalen he menge valey zan. Umbe mahabet is menge valey zan he egkengerundus. Iyan a, is Nengazen, is migkaǥi kayi.”
